theater: 黃金海岸內陸與阿散蒂疆界

battle.name: 第三次阿散蒂戰爭
battle.theater: 黃金海岸內陸與阿散蒂疆界
battle.brief: 一八七三年英國中止以沿海諸邦代打阿散蒂的舊策，翌年一月自普宜向內陸推進。阿莫阿富爾的土牆、奧達舒的第二道防線與波姆帕塔的還擊，構成這場戰爭的硬骨頭；一八五○年代式的線膛野戰砲在此只作配角，英軍真正的火力已是後膛砲。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠。砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵。

countries: 英方是由三層構成的體系。決策層在倫敦：一八七三年自由黨政府放棄了多年的沿岸聯盟辦法，不再只出錢讓芬特沿岸諸邦代為攻打阿散蒂，改為派遣正規遠征軍。執行層是金海岸總督府，負責對外談判、召集會盟、接收割讓地；作戰層是加內特·沃爾斯利中將指揮的英軍遠征軍，轄下有三十二步兵團（康沃爾輕步兵）、第二西印度團等步兵營、皇家砲兵的野戰砲隊與攻城砲隊、皇家工程兵、軍需兵，以及一批由豪薩地帶招來的僱兵。阿散蒂一方是內陸的邦聯國家：一七○一年由奧塞·圖圖在庫馬西建立的聯盟，以阿散蒂王為共主，之下是數十個各自獨立的酋邦，兵源是各邦的世襲家臣與自備火槍的民兵，幾乎沒有成建制的野戰砲兵，軍隊只在王室召喚時才由各邦拼湊起來。實力上英方遠勝，但阿散蒂掌握內陸的樹林道路與糧秣，英軍必須靠海運把部隊送上岸，再沿一條樹林中的單一道路深入，因此無法繞開阿散蒂預先選定的那條會戰走廊。
countriesEn: The British side was a structure built in three layers. The decision layer sat in London: in 1873 the Liberal government abandoned the coastal alliance system under which the Fante and other coastal states had been paid to fight the Asante on Britain's behalf, and decided instead to send a regular expeditionary force. The executive layer was the Gold Coast governor's establishment, responsible for negotiations with the Asante, for summoning the assembly, and for taking over the ceded territory. The operational layer was the British expeditionary army commanded by Lieutenant-General Garnet Wolseley, comprising the 32nd Foot (Cornwall Light Infantry), the 2nd West India Regiment and other infantry companies, the field and siege batteries of the Royal Artillery, the Royal Engineers, the Army Service Corps, and a body of Hausa recruits hired in the Hausa territories. The Asante side was an inland confederacy: the league founded in 1701 by Osei Tutu at Kumasi, with the Asantehene as its head, composed of several score of mutually independent chiefdoms. Its manpower came from the hereditary retainers of each chiefdom and from militia who carried their own muskets; it had almost no field artillery worth the name, and its armies existed only when the royal court called them together. In raw strength the British were far ahead, but the Asante held the inland forest roads and the food supply, while the British had to put their army ashore by sea and then move it along a single road through the forest, so they could not sidestep the corridor the Asante had chosen for the meeting engagement.
people: 英方最關鍵的人物是加內特·沃爾斯利中將。他此前已指揮一八六八年攻入阿比西尼亞的遠征與一八六九至一八七○年的紅河遠征，學會在缺乏補給的地區用速度換取戰果；一八七三年他被派到黃金海岸，主持普宜會盟，並在會盟破裂後組織這次遠征。他的作風是先嚴密封鎖海岸，再集中一支能連續行軍的縱隊，不分散兵力，不急於求成，每到一處就攻下一處防線，再往下一處推。海軍方面由東印度艦隊司令喬治·特里昂海軍上將統率封鎖與海上支援，以巡洋艦為旗艦的分隊負責砲擊埃爾米納堡壘、肅清湖上的阿散蒂小艇，並輸送彈藥與糧秣。阿散蒂方面，阿散蒂王科菲·卡里卡里是全場衝突的核心：他是英方要求交出的人質之一，也是拒絕交出的人，一八七四年初焚城北走，最後在象牙海岸方向的賈曼地區被英軍搜索隊於二月十日捕捉，四月死在普宜的囚禁中。率軍的阿散蒂將領阿曼夸提亞，以及在普宜會盟中代表阿散蒂發言的祭司夸多沃，同樣是關鍵人物。英方陣營裡還有金海岸總督府的代表、英國僑商團體，以及受英國資助的沿海諸邦酋長，他們在會盟中被要求表態。
peopleEn: The decisive British figure was Lieutenant-General Garnet Wolseley. He had already commanded the Abyssinian expedition of 1868 and the Red River expedition of 1869 to 1870, and had learned to trade speed for results in regions where supply was scarce; in 1873 he was sent to the Gold Coast to preside over the assembly at Cape Coast and, when that assembly broke up, to organise the campaign. His method was to seal the coast by blockade first, then concentrate a single column capable of marching continuously, never to scatter, never to hurry, to take one line at a time and only then move to the next. On the naval side the blockade and sea support were run by Admiral Sir George Tryon, commander of the East Indies Station; the squadron under the flag of Druid bombarded the castle of Elmina, cleared the Asante craft off the lake, and carried ammunition and stores. On the Asante side the central figure of the whole war was the Asantehene Kofi Karikari: he was one of the hostages Britain demanded and the one who refused to surrender, and in early 1874 he burned the capital and withdrew north, to be caught by a British search party in the Jaman country towards the Ivory Coast on 10 February and to die in captivity at Cape Coast in April. The Asante commander Amankwatia, and the priest Kwadwo who spoke for the Asante at the Cape Coast assembly, were also key figures. On the British side there were in addition the representatives of the Gold Coast government, the body of British merchant residents, and the chiefs of the coastal states who were funded by Britain, all of whom were called upon to take a position at the assembly.
kits: 線膛砲在這場戰役裡是一件正在退場的兵器。任務所載的這門一八五○年德製線膛野戰砲，代表普魯士式的前裝滑膛野戰砲：鑄鐵炮身、青銅襯套，以球形實心彈與霰彈作戰，標稱射程一千至一千五百碼，實用射程六百至八百碼，射速每分鐘一至兩發；其砲兵準則是列陣射擊，砲隊排成單行與步兵協同，進至射程即停，開火後由步兵再往前推。放進一八七四年的金海岸，這門砲有兩重意義。第一重是它代表的能力已經過時：到一八七○年代初，英軍野戰砲早已換成阿姆斯特朗與倫敦皇家砲廠的後膛線膛砲，以球形榴彈為主；前裝滑膛野戰砲多已退入儲存列裝，只在後膛砲補充不及時才會上陣。第二重是它仍能決定攻堅節奏：阿莫阿富爾那道高約六公尺、長約七百多公尺的土木寨牆，英軍以野戰砲連續射擊在一天之內打開缺口，步兵隨即突入；對照一八二四年英軍攻庫馬西必須靠攻城砲隊在城外圍攻半年以上，同樣是土牆，砲兵一代之差就讓戰爭從半年縮到幾周。德國這個出處還有另一層意思：一八六○年代起，普魯士砲廠已向各國輸出後膛重砲，英國殖民地購買的正是德製砲；於是在一八七○年代，德國砲這個標籤同時可以指最落後的滑膛前裝野戰砲，也可以指最前進的後膛重砲。阿散蒂一方幾乎沒有野戰砲兵，守城靠土牆、射孔與前裝火槍的近距離齊射；英軍則有皇家砲兵的野戰砲隊，以及海軍分隊送上陸的前裝重砲，在埃爾米納與阿莫阿富爾提供壓制。步槍方面，第三十二團與第二西印度團裝備的是恩菲爾與馬尼蒂亨利式後膛步槍，據說這場戰爭是馬尼蒂亨利最早的實戰之一。運輸方面，海軍把砲車、彈藥與糧秣卸上陸，再由騾隊與軍需兵車隊沿那條由工兵連夜開出的道路推進；阿散蒂王的行李、器物與金凳則以大象馱運北撤。
kitsEn: The muzzle-loading field gun was a weapon on its way out in this campaign. The gun on this card, a German muzzle-loading field gun of 1850, represents the Prussian type: a cast-iron barrel with a bronze lining, firing spherical solid shot and canister, with a nominal range of one thousand to fifteen hundred yards and a service range of six hundred to eight hundred yards at one or two rounds a minute. Its artillery doctrine was the line-of-battle: guns drawn up in single rank in support of the infantry, halted at range, fired, and the infantry pushed on afterwards. Placed on the Gold Coast in 1874, the gun carried two meanings. The first was that the capability it represented was already obsolete: by the early 1870s the British field artillery had been rearmed with the Armstrong and RBL breech-loading rifled guns firing spherical shell; muzzle-loading smoothbore field pieces had mostly gone into stores and were brought forward only when breech guns could not be supplied fast enough. The second was that it still set the tempo of a siege: the earthwork at Amoaful, about six metres high and more than seven hundred metres long, was opened by field guns firing through a single afternoon, and the infantry went in at once; by contrast the British capture of Kumasi in 1824 had required a siege train to batter at the town for more than half a year. Against the same kind of earthwork, a single generation of artillery cut the war from months to weeks. The German origin carries a second layer of meaning as well: from the 1860s the Prussian gun factories were exporting heavy breech-loading guns around the world, and the guns the British colonies bought were German; in the 1870s the label German gun could thus denote both the most backward smoothbore muzzle-loader and the most advanced heavy breech-loader. The Asante had almost no field artillery at all, and relied on earthworks, loopholes and close-range volleys from muzzle-loading muskets; the British had the Royal Artillery field batteries and the heavy muzzle-loading pieces landed from the naval squadron, which gave the Asante the weight of fire they lacked at Elmina and Amoaful. For small arms, the 32nd Foot and the 2nd West India Regiment carried the Enfield and the Martini-Henry, and this campaign is said to be among the first actions in which the Martini-Henry saw service. On the transport side the navy landed the guns, ammunition and stores, which were then drawn forward along the road the engineers had cut through the bush by night in mule teams and Army Service Corps wagons; the Asantehene's baggage, his regalia and the Golden Stool were carried north on elephants.
tactics: 英軍的戰術是一條線一條線地吃：先封鎖海岸，切斷阿散蒂從外部取得火砲與火藥的管道，再以一支能連續行軍的縱隊沿普宜通往內陸的單一道路推進，先鋒邊打邊修路。工兵在阿莫阿富爾以北連夜開出約十二英里、寬到能讓砲車通過的道路，使砲隊得以跟上班兵線；縱隊不越過自己的前線，攻克一道防線就停下來鞏固，再攻下一道。攻擊阿莫阿富爾時，砲兵先以實心彈與霰彈在土牆上打開缺口，步兵第二西印度團與三十二步兵團隨即以縱隊突入缺口，佔領寨牆後才展開。阿散蒂的戰術是拒絕決戰、利用工事與縱深。庫馬西方向布了三道防線，第一道在阿莫阿富爾，第二道在奧達舒；每一道都是土木牆加射孔，步兵退到牆後以密集隊形射擊。英軍進入庫馬西時，城已被阿散蒂自己焚燒，人員、物資與金凳北撤，於是英軍面對的是空城。往北的追擊變成搜索戰：英軍以小股分遣隊沿象牙海岸方向搜索，英軍縱隊在二月初擊破波姆帕塔的還擊，沃爾斯利本人在那場戰鬥中手上負傷。天氣是整場戰役的變數：一月到二月的哈馬坦乾霧降低能見度，也使連續射擊與補給變得困難；三月的雨季尚未到，正是英方選在旱季作戰的理由，而雨季一旦提前，道路就會變成泥濘，砲車與騾隊的推進速度會成倍下降。
tacticsEn: The British method was to swallow the Asante defences one line at a time. First the coast was blockaded, cutting the Asante off from guns and powder bought from outside; then a single column that could march continuously was pushed along the one road running inland from Cape Coast, with the pioneers cutting road as they fought. The engineers cut a road of about twelve miles north of Amoaful, by night and wide enough for the guns to pass, so the artillery could keep up with the line of infantry; the column never pushed past its own leading troops, took one line, halted to consolidate, and only then went on to the next. At Amoaful the guns opened a gap in the earthwork with solid shot and canister, and the 2nd West India Regiment and the 32nd Foot went in through it in column, deploying only after the rampart was taken. The Asante method was to refuse battle and to use works and depth. Three lines were prepared towards Kumasi, the first at Amoaful, the second at Ordashu; each was a rampart of earth with loopholes, behind which the infantry fired in dense formation. By the time the British entered Kumasi the town had been burned by the Asante themselves, with the men, the stores and the Golden Stool carried north, so what the British faced was an empty city. The pursuit north became a search: small detachments were pushed towards the Ivory Coast, and the column broke the counter-attack at Bompata in early February, where Wolseley himself was wounded in the hand. Weather was the variable of the whole campaign. The harmattan of January and February cut visibility and made sustained fire and supply work harder; the rains of March had not yet arrived, which was precisely why the British chose the dry season, and had the rains come early the roads would have turned to mud and the speed of the guns and the mule teams would have fallen several times over.
data: 可以核對的數字大致如下。英軍出戰兵力約三千人上下，包括數個英軍步兵營、皇家砲兵、皇家工程兵、軍需兵與僱兵，海軍分隊另有海軍陸戰隊與水兵數百；封鎖由東印度艦隊的艦隊與巡邏艇執行。阿莫阿富爾一役（一八七四年一月二十四日），英方記錄的傷亡為陣亡十八人、受傷九十一人，阿散蒂方面的損失只有數百人左右的概數。一八七四年一月底至二月初的奧達舒與波姆帕塔兩役，英軍傷亡較重，陣亡數十人；整個野戰階段英軍陣亡約在百人上下，受傷數百人。阿散蒂王於一八七四年二月十日在象牙海岸邊境的賈曼地區被捕，四月死於普宜的囚禁中。距離與時間方面，普宜到庫馬西沿路約二百公里；阿莫阿富爾離海岸約四十公里；工兵開出的道路約十二英里。前線作戰自一八七四年一月二十四日到二月十日，前後不足三周；對照一八二四年英軍攻下庫馬西歷時半年以上，差距極為明顯。割讓與賠款方面，一八七四年一月的公約規定阿散蒂割出沿海岸縱深約三十英里、寬約一百英里的一片土地，並以十萬盎司黃金（約合五萬英鎊）賠償英國，賠款於一八七四至一八七五年分期支付。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The British force in the field numbered about three thousand men, made up of several British infantry companies, the Royal Artillery, the Royal Engineers, the Army Service Corps and hired troops, with several hundred marines and sailors from the naval squadron; the blockade was run by the ships and patrol boats of the East Indies Station. At Amoaful, on 24 January 1874, the British record of casualties gives eighteen men killed and ninety-one wounded, while the Asante loss is only a rough figure of several hundred. At Ordashu and Bompata, from the end of January to the beginning of February 1874, British casualties were heavier, with several dozen killed; over the whole field phase of the war British dead were of the order of a hundred and the wounded numbered several hundred. The Asantehene was taken on 10 February 1874 in the Jaman country on the border of the Ivory Coast, and died in captivity at Cape Coast in April. On distances and timing, the road from Cape Coast to Kumasi runs about two hundred kilometres; Amoaful lies some forty kilometres from the coast; the road cut by the engineers measured about twelve miles. Fighting in the field ran from 24 January to 10 February 1874, a little under three weeks; set against the more than half a year the British needed to take Kumasi in 1824, the difference is striking. On cession and indemnity, the convention of January 1874 required the Asante to cede a strip along the coast about one hundred miles wide and thirty miles deep, and to make reparation to Britain of one hundred thousand ounces of gold, roughly fifty thousand pounds, paid in instalments between 1874 and 1875.
cause: 這場戰爭的直接起因是阿散蒂對通往海岸的道路與貿易的壟斷。十八世紀末到十九世紀中葉，阿散蒂聯邦對南部各邦有宗主權，向經過其地界的貨物徵收通行稅，並逐步企圖把芬特沿岸的商路收進自己手裡；而阿散蒂內陸出產的金砂、象牙與可可，恰恰要靠這些受它庇蔭的海岸港口運出去。英國商人與殖民當局長期不滿，希望削弱阿散蒂的壟斷，卻受限於成本，不願自己出兵。一八六九年阿散蒂大軍越過邊界向芬特與登基拉一帶進攻，兵臨普宜，迫使英國出手解圍；一八七○年解圍之後，英方檢討舊策，認定既然無法長期以少量錢財讓沿海諸邦代打，不如自己出兵一次把阿散蒂打敗。於是一八七三年自由黨政府批准遠征，加內特·沃爾斯利被派赴黃金海岸，主持一八七三年二月在普宜召開的會盟。會盟上英方提出的要求包括：歸還掠走的沿海財產、賠償過去數年的損失，並交出阿散蒂王與金凳作為信物。阿散蒂方面答覆金凳並不在可以交付之列，會盟因而破裂，隨後阿散蒂向海岸諸城發動進攻。外部因素同樣重要：北歐與德國商人持續向阿散蒂供應火槍與火砲，而阿散蒂若完成軍事現代化並把海上貿易線握在手中，英國在黃金海岸的航運與開普至印度的航線都會受威脅。英國在非洲的擴張至此已不只是在爭一條商路，而是在爭一個能長久維持的海灣基地。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the war was the Asante monopoly on the roads and the trade that led to the coast. From the late eighteenth century to the middle of the nineteenth the Asante confederacy held suzerainty over the southern states, levied tolls on goods that crossed its territory, and had gradually tried to bring the trade of the Fante coast into its own hands; and the gold dust, ivory and cocoa of the Asante interior could only be shipped out through the very coastal ports the Asante protected. British merchants and the colonial authorities were long dissatisfied and wanted the Asante grip loosened, but cost kept them from fighting themselves. In 1869 the Asante army crossed the frontier into the Fante and Denkyira country and came down on Cape Coast, forcing Britain to relieve the town; after the relief of 1870 the British reviewed the old arrangement and concluded that if the coastal states could not be paid to do the fighting indefinitely, it was better to raise an army and beat the Asante once. In 1873 the Liberal government approved the expedition, Garnet Wolseley was sent to the Gold Coast, and in February 1873 he presided over the assembly at Cape Coast. The British demands there were the return of coastal property carried off, compensation for several years of losses, and the surrender of the Asantehene and the Golden Stool as tokens. The Asante answered that the Golden Stool was not among the things that could be handed over, the assembly broke up, and the Asante moved to attack the coastal towns. Outside factors mattered as well: merchants in northern Europe and Germany kept supplying muskets and cannon to the Asante, and if the Asante completed their military modernisation and took the seaborne trade into their own hands, British shipping on the Gold Coast and the Cape-to-India route would both be at risk. By this point British expansion in Africa was no longer the pursuit of a trade road alone but the pursuit of a bay that could be held for good.
impact: 影響首先是阿散蒂宗主權的解體。一八七四年公約之後，芬特沿岸與阿克維姆等地的南部各邦脫離阿散蒂聯盟，直接納入英國管治；英國在庫馬西派駐代表，阿散蒂的疆域被壓縮到傳統腹地，這個西非最大的內陸政權降為一個受英國監督的區域性聯盟。賠款十萬盎司黃金分兩年支付，阿散蒂不得不變賣部分產業並向英商借貸，財政由此轉為緊張，酋邦之間的分配矛盾加深。第二是戰爭模式的變化。英軍在這次遠征中把後膛野戰砲、新式步槍、蒸汽輪船的運力與嚴整的軍需組織整套帶進西非內陸，結果是一場深入內陸二百公里的帝國戰役在三周內結束，與一八二四年長達半年的攻城形成強烈對照。這種以海軍為骨、以技術壓倒的遠征模式，後來成為英國在非洲的標準做法，也影響了歐洲列強對開闢內陸的成本估算。第三是金凳。一八七四年金凳被帶往北方，此後二十六年成為阿散蒂人反英的象徵：一九○○年爆發以金凳為名的起義，改革派借機要求結束實質上的殖民統治。一九三五年英國恢復阿散蒂聯邦理事會，一九四六年恢復阿散蒂王的權位，二○○○年金凳回到庫馬西。加納獨立後，阿散蒂地區成為國家的一個行政區，而這段被記住的歷史，成為二十世紀加納政治與文化裡不斷被引用的一部分。
impactEn: The first effect was the dissolution of Asante suzerainty. After the convention of 1874 the southern states, in the Fante coast and in places such as Akwamu, left the confederacy and came directly under British administration; Britain posted a resident at Kumasi, the Asante territories were compressed back into the old heartland, and what had been the largest inland state in West Africa became a regional league under British supervision. The indemnity of one hundred thousand ounces of gold was paid over two years, and the Asante had to sell part of their property and borrow from British merchants to meet it; their finances grew tight and the quarrels over how the burden should be shared between the chiefdoms deepened. The second effect was a change in the pattern of war. In this expedition the British carried breech-loading field guns, new pattern rifles, the carrying capacity of steamships and a strict logistics system as a set into the West African interior, and the result was that an imperial campaign two hundred kilometres deep ended in three weeks, in sharp contrast with the siege of half a year in 1824. A mode of expedition resting on the navy and on technical superiority became the British standard in Africa afterwards, and it altered European estimates of what it cost to open up an interior. The third effect was the Golden Stool. Carried north in 1874, it became for the next twenty-six years the symbol of Asante resistance to Britain; the rising of 1900 was named after it, and the reformers used it to press for an end to colonial rule in everything but name. Britain restored the Asante confederacy council in 1935 and the Asantehene in 1946, and in 2000 the Golden Stool returned to Kumasi. After Ghanaian independence the Asante area became one of the regions of the new state, and the remembered history of this war has remained a part of Ghanaian politics and culture ever since.
result: 結果是一場英方速勝而阿散蒂實體存續的戰爭。軍事上，阿莫阿富爾的缺口、奧達舒的突破與波姆帕塔的還擊被擊退，庫馬西在英軍進入時已被阿散蒂自己焚燒，只剩空城與焦土；阿散蒂王的行李與金凳往北退入象牙海岸方向，隊伍在缺糧、缺彈藥與缺援的情況下解散，阿散蒂王本人於一八七四年二月十日被搜索隊在賈曼地區捕捉。這與一八二四年不同：一八二四年英軍雖然攻下庫馬西，卻在深入內陸後幾乎耗盡，無力佔領；一八七四年英軍靠海運補給，勝了之後還能守住海岸線。政治上，阿散蒂於一八七四年一月底在普宜與英方代表簽訂公約，承認割讓沿海的一片土地，並承諾十萬盎司黃金的賠償。一八七五年英國任命駐阿散蒂代表，監督其內政與財政，阿散蒂聯邦在形式上仍然存在，酋邦仍保有各自的軍隊與酋長，但對南部各邦的宗主權正式終止。一八七四年十月起阿散蒂內陸仍有零星抵抗，英軍又花了半年才把局勢完全壓平；從一八七五年起，維持在邊境線上的秩序取代了戰爭。最終的戰果清單很簡單：英軍陣亡約百人，庫馬西被燒成廢墟，阿散蒂王死在囚禁之中，金凳留在北方沒有交出；這場戰爭換來的是英國在黃金海岸的一段直接統治，以及此後二十六年不斷累積的怨恨。
resultEn: The result was a quick British victory in which the Asante state nevertheless survived in physical form. Militarily the breach at Amoaful, the carry at Ordashu and the counter-attack at Bompata were all turned back, and Kumasi had been burned by the Asante themselves before the British entered it, so what remained was an empty town and scorched ground. The Asantehene's baggage and the Golden Stool were carried north towards the Ivory Coast, the column dissolved for want of food, ammunition and support, and the Asantehene himself was taken by a search party in the Jaman country on 10 February 1874. This differed from 1824, when the British took Kumasi but were so exhausted after pushing inland that they could not hold it; in 1874 the British were supplied by sea and could still keep the coast line after the victory. Politically the Asante concluded a convention with British representatives at Cape Coast at the end of January 1874, acknowledging the cession of a strip of coastal territory and undertaking the indemnity of one hundred thousand ounces of gold. In 1875 Britain appointed a resident to the Asante, supervising their internal affairs and finances; the confederacy continued to exist in form, the chiefdoms kept their own troops and chiefs, but suzerainty over the southern states ended for good. From October 1874 there were still scattered resistance movements in the interior and the British needed a further half year to close the situation down; from 1875 the order maintained along the frontier line took the place of the war. The final score sheet is simple: about a hundred British dead, Kumasi a burnt ruin, the Asantehene dead in captivity, and the Golden Stool never surrendered. What the war bought was a stretch of direct British rule on the Gold Coast, and twenty-six years of resentment accumulating behind it.
